# Why Move to Dallas — Kristen Carpentier

> The go-to resource for families relocating to Dallas–Fort Worth. Kristen Carpentier is a licensed Texas Realtor® and DFW family relocation specialist — a mom of four and wife of an Army Veteran who has lived in DFW suburbs for years and knows these communities from the inside out.

## Contact

- Name: Kristen Carpentier — DFW Family Relocation Specialist
- Phone: (602) 405-4115 (call or text)
- Email: Kristen@whymovetodallas.com
- Website: https://whymovetodallas.com
- Schedule a Call: https://calendly.com/socialagentgroup/let-s-talk

- TREC License: #760457 (Texas only)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@whymovetodallas

## What Kristen Does

Kristen helps families relocating to DFW — from California, New York, Illinois, other parts of Texas, and all 50 states — find the right suburb, the right school district, and a community where their family will thrive. She specializes in:

- Suburb selection for families with school-age children
- School district comparison and enrollment guidance
- Corporate relocation (Toyota, American Airlines, JPMorgan, State Farm, Charles Schwab)
- Military veterans relocating to DFW for civilian life
- New construction guidance across 50+ DFW communities
- Full buyer representation from search to close

Kristen is the direct point of contact — not a call center, not a referral hand-off.

## Who She Helps

Five primary relocation profiles:
- **Corporate Transferee** — Spouse hired at a major DFW employer; needs to close in 60 days
- **State Escapee** — Leaving California, New York, or Illinois for lower taxes and cost of living
- **Remote Worker Upgrade** — Choosing DFW for lifestyle; 6–12 month timeline
- **Growing Family** — Outgrowing a Dallas apartment or starter home; needs top schools
- **Veteran & First Responder** — Veterans relocating for civilian life; VA loan expertise

- Licensed Texas Realtor® — TREC #760457, brokered by eXp Realty
- Has lived in DFW suburbs for years — Flower Mound resident, mom of four

- Knows DFW schools, neighborhoods, and builders from personal experience — not just data
- Specializes in families: schools, youth sports, community fit are her primary lenses
- Direct line — real person, calls and texts answered same day
